sv.title: Experten säker – Andrew kommer fly till Mellanöstern
sv.summary: Den före detta prins Andrew riskerar åtal nästa år. Då kommer han sannolikt fly till Mellanöstern. Det tror kungliga experten Andrew Lownie.

en.title: Expert certain – Andrew will flee to the Middle East
en.summary: The former prince Andrew risks being charged next year. He will then likely flee to the Middle East. That is what royal expert Andrew Lownie believes.
